label: champ_0160_chairman_02
text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳終於要挑戰\n寶可夢聯盟了。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0160_chairman_03
text: 晉升冠軍級必經的\n最終測驗……[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0160_chairman_05
text: 我由衷祝福[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n能夠展現最佳的表現。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0160_chairman_06
text: 期待稍後與[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳相會喔。[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
